staged_as: arcade cabinet -- SOKOBAN: push every crate, and the crates never pull
note: Three levels. 01 is the FLOOR of the scale. 02 is 12 moves and punishes a player that cannot re-approach: after the first crate is placed the player must walk around to the far side of the other one. 03 is THE CORNER WAITING: a two-move push puts the crate in the right-hand corner where it can never be moved again, and the board does not say so. Every optimum below was VERIFIED by exhaustive BFS over the whole state space before any entrant ran, not asserted from a level file. Level 02 has THIRTEEN distinct 12-move solutions: the optimum is a fact, 'the plan' is not. Nothing in this instrument ever compares a move stream to a reference plan -- it executes it. [G18]

criteria_frozen_before_run.C1_answer_is_executed: the answer is checked by EXECUTING it through step(); never by reading it and comparing it to a known plan
criteria_frozen_before_run.C2_four_outcomes: moved/pushed, blocked, give_up and not_an_action are four counters, and a malformed answer is never a wrong move
criteria_frozen_before_run.C3_no_truncation: more than one letter is not_an_action; the first character is never taken
criteria_frozen_before_run.C4_zero_rule: a run with zero measured entrants is an ERROR (non-zero exit), never a verdict; never_started is counted separately from played-and-failed
criteria_frozen_before_run.C5_record_before_verdict: the record is written to disk BEFORE the success/failure branch
criteria_frozen_before_run.C6_exit_code_reflects_the_run: the exit code comes from the run, and the self-test drives every path that returns one

declared_per_run.reasoning: on | off | unset -- DECLARED before the run; 'unset' is NOT 'off' and must not be pooled [A11]
